# Dennis Munania

> Cybersecurity analyst and Flutter / full stack developer based in Thika, Kenya. Available for security assessments, secure app development, and systems administration contract work.

Dennis works across network security, vulnerability assessment, incident response, and full stack development (Flutter, React). He holds a Cisco Ethical Hacker certification, a Cyber Shujaa Cloud and Network Security certification, and a Qualys Vulnerability Management certification, and has hands on experience with Wazuh SIEM and ISO 27001 aligned documentation.

- [Contact](https://dennismunania.com/contact.html): direct contact details and a message form

## Services

- Security Assessments: vulnerability scanning, OWASP Top 10 web app testing, SIEM setup and threat monitoring, ISO 27001 aligned documentation
- Secure App Development: Flutter mobile apps with offline first architecture, React web front ends, Firebase auth and API integration
- Systems & Network Admin: LAN/WAN setup and hardening, intrusion detection and log monitoring, Docker/Kubernetes deployment support
- Security & Tech Audits: website and systems reviews covering security, performance, and compliance, delivered as a prioritized action plan
